hooks.name: validate-teletext-pages
hooks.description: Validate generated page/content JSON against the teletext authenticity rules whenever such a file is saved.

action.prompt: A page or content JSON file was just saved. Validate it against .kiro/steering/teletext-rules.md: exactly 25 rows of 40 cells, only the 8-color palette, header contains a 100-899 page number and service name, fastext row has four links colored red/green/yellow/cyan. Report any violation with its row/column position, and fix the file directly when the fix is unambiguous.
